title: Path Parameters
description: Capture dynamic values from the URL path.

slides.title: Path Parameters 🌐
Multiple Path Parameters
slides.content: You can have multiple path parameters.

quizData.question: Given the route `@app.get("/items/{item_id}")`, how would you access the item ID in the function?
quizData.explanation: FastAPI automatically maps path parameters to function parameters with the same name.

slides.title: Path Order Matters
Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content: Use type hints for path parameters to get automatic validation and documentation. FastAPI will handle type conversion and error messages for you.
